standard.summary: 当前训练仅使用当前批次的 1 对，不增加额外前向传播。请保持 1；大于 1 的值保留兼容，但不会增加采样对数。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Current training uses one pair from the current batch with no extra forward passes. Keep 1; larger values are retained for compatibility and do not add sampling pairs.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 当前训练仅使用当前批次的 1 对，不增加额外前向传播。请保持 1；大于 1 的值保留兼容，但不会增加采样对数。

advanced_en.principle: Current training only uses 1 pair from the current batch, with no extra forward passes. Keep it at 1; values above 1 are kept for compatibility but do not increase sampled pairs.
